user.title: Set up KaminOfenWaechter
user.description: Pick the temperature sensor that measures your flue gas. A K-type thermocouple on an ESP32 via ESPHome is ideal – see the README for hardware options.

fan.title: Stove fan
fan.description: Optional. KaminOfenWaechter controls an existing fan or switch entity based on the flue gas temperature. The fan must only move room air, never combustion air.
